```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

plot_metabolite_kinetics_pdf <- function(
    repo_local_dir = NULL,
    pdf_output_path,
    selected_tissue = "blood",
    gsutil_cmd = "gsutil"
) {
  # --- 1. Load required libraries ---
  required_libs <- c(
    "dplyr", "ggplot2", "tidyverse", "glue",
    "MotrpacHumanPreSuspension", "MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData",
    "openxlsx"
  )
  missing_libs <- required_libs[!sapply(required_libs, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(missing_libs) > 0) {
    stop(paste0("Missing packages: ", paste(missing_libs, collapse = ", "),
                ". Please install them first."))
  }
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(lapply(required_libs, library, character.only = TRUE))
  
  plot_dir  <- dirname(pdf_output_path)
  
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Plot output directory: {plot_dir}"))
  }
  
  # --- 2. Set colors ---
  color_exercise <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspension::HUMAN_EXERCISE_GROUP_COLORS
  color_resist <- color_exercise[["ADUResist"]]
  color_endur <- color_exercise[["ADUEndur"]]
  color_control <- color_exercise[["ADUControl"]]
  
  # --- 3. Load DA data ---
  differential_analysis <- load_differential_analysis(
    repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
    selected_omes = "all",
    selected_tissues = selected_tissue,
    single_matrix = TRUE,
    combine_with_featgene = TRUE,
    epigen = FALSE,
    gsutil = gsutil_cmd
    
  ) %>%
    filter(contrast_type == "exercise_with_controls") %>%
    mutate(
      assay = if_else(str_detect(assay, "metab"), "metab", assay),
      gene_symbol = if_else(assay == "metab", feature_id, gene_symbol)
    )
  
  # --- 4. Filter for blood metabolites ---
  differential_analysis_metab_targeted <- differential_analysis %>%
    filter(tissue == "blood", assay == "metab") %>%
    distinct(feature_id, p_value, randomGroupCode, Timepoint, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # --- 5. Compute significance for each group/timepoint ---
  targeted_df_post_10_min_ADUEndur <- differential_analysis_metab_targeted %>%
    filter(Timepoint == "post_10_min", randomGroupCode == "ADUEndur") %>%
    mutate(sig = ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.05, "FDR Significant",
                        ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Nominal Significant", "Not Significant"))) %>%
    arrange(desc(sig), desc(p_value))
  
  targeted_df_post_10_min_ADUResist <- differential_analysis_metab_targeted %>%
    filter(Timepoint == "post_10_min", randomGroupCode == "ADUResist") %>%
    mutate(sig = ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.05, "FDR Significant",
                        ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Nominal Significant", "Not Significant"))) %>%
    arrange(desc(sig), desc(p_value))
  
  # --- 6. Define significant opposite-response features (placeholder logic) ---
  # ⚠️ The object `post_10_min_targeted_df` wasn’t defined in your original code,
  # so we’ll assume you meant to merge the two datasets:
  post_10_min_targeted_df <- full_join(
    targeted_df_post_10_min_ADUEndur %>% 
      dplyr::select(feature_id, post_10_min_ADUEndur_logFC = logFC, 
             sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUEndur = sig),
    targeted_df_post_10_min_ADUResist %>% 
      dplyr::select(feature_id, post_10_min_ADUResist_logFC = logFC, 
             sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUResist = sig),
    by = "feature_id"
  )
  
  # Keep only those significant and opposite direction
  significant_features_post_10_min <- post_10_min_targeted_df %>%
    filter(sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUResist == "FDR Significant" &
             sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUEndur == "FDR Significant") %>%
    filter((post_10_min_ADUEndur_logFC > 0 & post_10_min_ADUResist_logFC < 0) |
             (post_10_min_ADUEndur_logFC < 0 & post_10_min_ADUResist_logFC > 0)) %>%
    distinct(feature_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(diff = post_10_min_ADUEndur_logFC - post_10_min_ADUResist_logFC) %>%
    arrange(diff)
  
  significant_feature_ids <- significant_features_post_10_min$feature_id
  
  # --- 7. Filter full dataset for these features ---
  filtered_data <- differential_analysis_metab_targeted %>%
    filter(Timepoint %in% c("pre_exercise", "post_10_min", "post_15_30_45_min",
                            "post_24_hr", "post_3.5_4_hr")) %>%
    filter(feature_id %in% significant_feature_ids &
             randomGroupCode %in% c("ADUResist", "ADUEndur", "ADUControl")) %>%
    distinct(feature_id, randomGroupCode, Timepoint, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # Add baseline
  baseline_data <- filtered_data %>%
    distinct(feature_id, randomGroupCode) %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = "baseline", logFC = 0)
  
  filtered_data <- bind_rows(filtered_data, baseline_data)
  
  # --- 8. Label and order timepoints ---
  timepoint_labels <- c(
    "baseline" = "Pre-Exercise",
    "pre_exercise" = "Pre-Exercise",
    "during_20_min" = "During 20 Min",
    "during_40_min" = "During 40 Min",
    "post_10_min" = "Post 10 Min",
    "post_15_30_45_min" = "Post 30 Min",
    "post_3.5_4_hr" = "Post 3.5 Hour",
    "post_24_hr" = "Post 24 Hour"
  )
  
  filtered_data$Timepoint <- factor(filtered_data$Timepoint,
                                    levels = c("baseline", "pre_exercise", "post_10_min",
                                               "post_15_30_45_min", "post_3.5_4_hr", "post_24_hr"))
  
  # --- 9. Create plot ---
  p <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = logFC, color = randomGroupCode, group = randomGroupCode)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("ADUEndur" = color_endur, "ADUResist" = color_resist),
      labels = c("ADUEndur" = "EE", "ADUResist" = "RE")
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = timepoint_labels) +
    labs(
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = "logFC",
      color = "Group",
      title = ""
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ feature_id, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11.5),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
    )
  
  # --- 10. Save PDF safely ---
  ggsave(
    filename = pdf_output_path,
    plot = p,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    width = 14,
    height = 10,
    units = "in",
    limitsize = FALSE,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  message("✅ Metabolite kinetics PDF saved to: ", pdf_output_path)
  return(p)
}

```
